title: Never hand-edit files under an app's npdev-generated/ -- it is hash-verified
body: The `npdev-generated/` tree inside a generated FinalApp is hash-verified: any post-generation edit to a file there will be detected/rejected (or silently overwritten on the next regeneration). Do not patch generated output in place to "fix" something. Change the source instead -- the model, the generator template/emitter, or the app-owned static assets that live OUTSIDE npdev-generated/ (e.g. web/ overrides). If an app is served via a static-locations flag, note the jar copy of a static asset can be stale relative to the on-disk file; regenerate rather than editing the guarded copy.
